name: Integration for Breakdance and WPML
author: Fran Nieto

sections.description:
Integration for Breakdance and WPML is an integration plugin that connects the Breakdance visual builder with WPML, enabling multilingual websites built entirely with Breakdance.

The plugin adds compatibility between both plugins so that content created with the builder can be properly translated using WPML, while preserving Breakdance structure and design.

Features

  • Allows translating pages created with Breakdance, including their content and structure.
  • Supports translation of Breakdance templates such as headers, footers, global blocks, and popups.
  • Adds a language condition that can be applied to any Breakdance element and template, allowing content to be shown or hidden based on the active language.

short_description: Integrates Breakdance with WPML to translate the content of any page or template created with the builder.
